task: Franka Panda pushes a 4 cm cube from its start pose into a circular target region on the floor using closed fingertips, without touching the floor with the hand or fingers and without any arm link touching anything.

goal.description: Block centre within target_radius_m of the target centre in the horizontal plane for stability_steps consecutive control steps, the window completing no later than deadline_s after episode start, and the block still inside the target at the final recorded step.
